ov: Slow-moving tree mammals of Central and South American rainforests, named for their very low metabolism. There are seven species: three-toed and two-toed sloths.
rg: Tropical rainforests of Central and South America.
df: Leaves, a low-energy diet that their slowness helps them live on.
fx: Sloths climb down to the ground about once every eight days to defecate.
notes: Group entry (seven species). The existing fact (green algae in the fur) is confirmed. sw:true is confirmed: sloths are almost helpless on the ground but can swim.
